in_sanskrit.name: Debojit
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's gift
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Debojit एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Debojit is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Deba’ meaning god and ‘Jit’ meaning victory or gift. This name signifies that the child is a gift from the gods. The name is associated with the god Shiva and is believed to bring prosperity, strength, and success.
